def writeU64Little (v : UInt64) : Vector UInt8 8 :=
  let n := v.toNat
  Vector.mk (List.ofFn fun i => UInt8.ofNat ((n / (256 ^ i.val)) % 256)) (by simp)

theorem writeU64Little_length (v : UInt64) : (writeU64Little v).toList.length = 8 := by
  simp [writeU64Little]

def writeI128Little (v : Int) : Vector UInt8 16 :=
  let n := (v % (2^128)).toNat
  Vector.mk (List.ofFn fun i => UInt8.ofNat ((n / (256 ^ i.val)) % 256)) (by simp)

theorem writeI128Little_length (v : Int) : (writeI128Little v).toList.length = 16 := by
  simp [writeI128Little]

def hexTable : Vector UInt8 16 :=
  ⟨"0123456789abcdef".toList.map (fun c => c.toUInt8), by
    simp only [List.length_map, List.length_string, "0123456789abcdef".length]
    decide⟩

def bytesToHexLower (in : Vector UInt8 n) : Vector UInt8 (n * 2) :=
  let rec loop (i : Nat) (acc : List UInt8) : List UInt8 :=
    if h : i < n then
      let b := in.get ⟨i, h⟩
      let h1 := hexTable.get ⟨(b.val / 16).toNat, by decide⟩
      let h2 := hexTable.get ⟨(b.val % 16).toNat, by decide⟩
      loop (i + 1) (h1 :: h2 :: acc)
    else acc
  Vector.mk (loop 0 []).reverse (by
    let fix := @loop
    have hlen : (fix 0 []).length = n * 2 := by
      let rec aux (i : Nat) (acc : List UInt8) : (fix i acc).length = acc.length + (n - i) * 2 := by
        simp only [fix]
        byCases hi : i < n
        case pos hi =>
          simp only [hi, ite_true, List.length_cons]
          rw [aux (i + 1) (hexTable.get ⟨(in.get ⟨i, hi⟩).val / 16, by decide⟩ :: hexTable.get ⟨(in.get ⟨i, hi⟩).val % 16, by decide⟩ :: acc)]
          omega
        case neg hi =>
          simp only [hi, ite_false]
          have hieq : i = n := by omega
          simp [hieq]
          omega
      simp only [List.length_nil, Nat.zero_add, Nat.sub_self, Nat.mul_zero, List.length]
      rw [aux 0 []]
      simp
    simp [List.length_reverse, hlen]
  )

theorem bytesToHexLower_length (in : Vector UInt8 n) : (bytesToHexLower in).toList.length = n * 2 := by
  simp [bytesToHexLower]

def ProcessingCore.tick (self : ProcessingCore) (is_active : Bool) : ProcessingCore :=
  if is_active then
    { self with cycles_active := self.cycles_active + 1, state := CoreState.active }
  else
    { self with
      cycles_idle := self.cycles_idle + 1,
      state := if self.state == CoreState.power_gated then CoreState.power_gated else CoreState.idle }

theorem ProcessingCore.tick_active_inc (self : ProcessingCore) :
  (self.tick true).cycles_active = self.cycles_active + 1 := by
  simp [tick]

theorem ProcessingCore.tick_idle_inc (self : ProcessingCore) :
  (self.tick false).cycles_idle = self.cycles_idle + 1 := by
  simp [tick]

theorem ProcessingCore.tick_active_state (self : ProcessingCore) :
  (self.tick true).state = CoreState.active := by
  simp [tick]

theorem ProcessingCore.tick_idle_state (self : ProcessingCore) (hgate : self.state ≠ CoreState.power_gated) :
  (self.tick false).state = CoreState.idle := by
  simp [tick]
  split
  case isTrue h =>
    rw [if_neg]
    simp at h
    exact h
  case isFalse h =>
    simp at h
    exact h
  exact hgate

def ProcessingCore.getWorkload (self : ProcessingCore) : Rat :=
  let total := self.cycles_active + self.cycles_idle
  if total = 0 then 0
  else self.cycles_active / total

theorem ProcessingCore.getWorkload_zero (self : ProcessingCore) (h : self.cycles_active = 0 ∧ self.cycles_idle = 0) :
  self.getWorkload = 0 := by
  simp [getWorkload, h]

theorem ProcessingCore.getWorkload_range (self : ProcessingCore) : self.getWorkload ≥ 0 ∧ self.getWorkload ≤ 1 := by
  simp [getWorkload]
  split
  case isTrue h =>
    simp
  case isFalse h =>
    constructor
    case left =>
      apply Rat.div_nonneg
      omega
      omega
    case right =>
      apply Rat.div_le_one
      omega
      omega

structure ContentAddressableStorage where
  storage : BlockStorage
  content_index : ContentIndex
  affinity_map : AffinityMap
  total_capacity : Nat
  used_capacity : Nat
  deriving Repr

def ContentAddressableStorage.init (capacity : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
  { storage := default
    content_index := default
    affinity_map := default
    total_capacity := capacity
    used_capacity := 0 }

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.init_used_capacity (cap : Nat) :
  (ContentAddressableStorage.init cap).used_capacity = 0 := by

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.init_storage_empty (cap : Nat) :

  simp [ContentAddressableStorage.init]

def sha256 (data : List UInt8) : Vector UInt8 32 :=
  let init := List.replicate 32 (0 : UInt8)
  let mixed := data.foldl (fun acc b =>
    acc.mapIdx (fun i x => x + b + (i.val.toUInt8 * 31))) init
  Vector.mk mixed (by simp)

def computeContentHash (data : List UInt8) : ContentHash :=
  let hash := sha256 data
  Vector.mk (hash.toList.take CONTENT_HASH_SIZE) (by
    simp only [List.length_take, List.length_replicate, min_self]
    exact content_hash_size_pos
  )

def computeBlockId (content_hash : ContentHash) (timestamp : Int) : BlockId :=
  let buf := content_hash.toList ++ (writeI128Little timestamp).toList
  let fullHash := sha256 buf
  Vector.mk (fullHash.toList.take BLOCK_ID_SIZE) (by
    simp only [List.length_take, List.length_replicate, min_self]
    exact block_id_size_pos
  )

theorem computeContentHash_deterministic (d1 d2 : List UInt8) (h : d1 = d2) :
  computeContentHash d1 = computeContentHash d2 := by
  simp [h]

def ContentAddressableStorage.containsBlock (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) : Bool :=
  Finmap.contains self.storage id

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.containsBlock_iff (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) :
  self.containsBlock id ↔ id ∈ self.storage := by
  simp [containsBlock, Finmap.contains, Finmap.mem_def]

def ContentAddressableStorage.getBlock (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) : Option MemoryBlock :=
  Finmap.lookup self.storage id

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.getBlock_mem (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) (block : MemoryBlock) :
  self.getBlock id = some block ↔ block ∈ self.storage ∧ block.block_id = id := by
  simp [getBlock, Finmap.lookup_eq_some]

def ContentAddressableStorage.store (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : List UInt8) (preferred_core : Option Nat) : Option (BlockId × ContentAddressableStorage) :=
  let content_hash := computeContentHash data
  match self.content_index.lookup content_hash with
  | some existing_blocks =>
    let rec findFirst (blocks : Finset BlockId) : Option BlockId :=
      blocks.toList.find? (fun id => self.storage.contains id)
    match findFirst existing_blocks with
    | some id =>
      let updateFn (b : MemoryBlock) : MemoryBlock := b.updateAccessTime
      let newStorage := Finmap.adjust self.storage id updateFn
      some (id, { self with storage := newStorage })
    | none =>
      let timestamp := self.used_capacity.toNat
      let block_id := computeBlockId content_hash timestamp
      let newBlock := MemoryBlock.init block_id content_hash data preferred_core
      let newStorage := Finmap.insert self.storage block_id newBlock
      let newCI := Finmap.adjust self.content_index content_hash (fun s => s ∪ {block_id})
      some (block_id, { self with storage := newStorage, content_index := newCI, used_capacity := self.used_capacity + data.length })
  | none =>
    let timestamp := self.used_capacity.toNat
    let block_id := computeBlockId content_hash timestamp
    let newBlock := MemoryBlock.init block_id content_hash data preferred_core
    let newStorage := Finmap.insert self.storage block_id newBlock
    let newCI := Finmap.insert self.content_index content_hash {block_id}
    some (block_id, { self with storage := newStorage, content_index := newCI, used_capacity := self.used_capacity + data.length })

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.store_increments_used (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : List UInt8) (pc : Option Nat) (hnew : ¬ (computeContentHash data ∈ self.content_index)) :
  let res := self.store data pc
  ∃ id st, res = some (id, st) ∧ st.used_capacity = self.used_capacity + data.length := by
  simp only [store]
  simp only [Finmap.lookup_eq_none_iff] at hnew
  simp [hnew]
  use computeBlockId (computeContentHash data) self.used_capacity.toNat

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.store_inserts_block (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : List UInt8) (pc : Option Nat) (hnew : ¬ (computeContentHash data ∈ self.content_index)) :
  let res := self.store data pc
  ∃ id st, res = some (id, st) ∧ st.containsBlock id := by
  simp only [store]
  simp only [Finmap.lookup_eq_none_iff] at hnew
  simp [hnew, containsBlock, Finmap.contains, Finmap.mem_def, Finmap.insert]
  use computeBlockId (computeContentHash data) self.used_capacity.toNat

def ContentAddressableStorage.retrieve (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) : Option (List UInt8) :=
  match self.storage.lookup id with
  | some block => some block.data
  | none => none

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.retrieve_none (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) (hn : ¬ self.containsBlock id) :
  self.retrieve id = none := by
  simp [retrieve, containsBlock, Finmap.contains] at hn ⊢
  exact Finmap.not_mem_lookup_iff.mpr hn

def ContentAddressableStorage.retrieveByContent (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : List UInt8) : Option BlockId :=
  let hash := computeContentHash data
  match self.content_index.lookup hash with
  | some ids => ids.toList.find? (fun id => self.storage.contains id)
  | none => none

def ContentAddressableStorage.entangleBlocks (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id1 id2 : BlockId) : Option ContentAddressableStorage :=
  if h1 : id1 ∈ self.storage ∧ id2 ∈ self.storage then
    if id1 ≠ id2 then
      let b1 := self.storage.lookup id1
      let b2 := self.storage.lookup id2
      match b1, b2 with
      | some block1, some block2 =>
        let nb1 := block1.addEntangledBlock id2
        let nb2 := block2.addEntangledBlock id1
        let st1 := Finmap.insert self.storage id1 { nb1 with state := MemoryBlockState.entangled }
        let st2 := Finmap.insert st1 id2 { nb2 with state := MemoryBlockState.entangled }
        some { self with storage := st2 }
      | _, _ => none
    else none
  else none

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.entangleBlocks_fails_same_id (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) :
  self.entangleBlocks id id = none := by
  simp [entangleBlocks]

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.entangleBlocks_fails_missing (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id1 id2 : BlockId) (h : id1 ∉ self.storage ∨ id2 ∉ self.storage) :
  self.entangleBlocks id1 id2 = none := by
  simp [entangleBlocks]
  split
  case isTrue hmem =>
    exfalso
    cases h with
    | inl h1 => exact h1 hmem.1
    | inr h2 => exact h2 hmem.2
  case isFalse hmem =>
    simp

def ContentAddressableStorage.migrateBlock (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) (target_core : Nat) : Option ContentAddressableStorage :=
  match self.storage.lookup id with
  | some block =>
    let updateAffinity (m : AffinityMap) (old : Option Nat) (new : Nat) (bid : BlockId) : AffinityMap :=
      match old with
      | some oc =>
        let m1 := m.adjust oc (fun s => s.erase id)
        m1.adjust new (fun s => s ∪ {id})
      | none =>
        m.adjust new (fun s => s ∪ {id})
    let newBlock := { block with affinity_core := some target_core, state := MemoryBlockState.allocated }
    let newStorage := Finmap.insert self.storage id newBlock
    let newAffinity := updateAffinity self.affinity_map block.affinity_core target_core id
    some { self with storage := newStorage, affinity_map := newAffinity }
  | none => none

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.migrateBlock_affinity (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) (target : Nat) (block : MemoryBlock) (hlookup : self.storage.lookup id = some block) :
  ∃ newSt, self.migrateBlock id target = some newSt ∧ (newSt.storage.lookup id).map (·.affinity_core) = some (some target) := by
  simp [migrateBlock, hlookup]
  use { storage := Finmap.insert self.storage id { block with affinity_core := some target, state := MemoryBlockState.allocated },
        affinity_map := (block.affinity_core.map (fun oc => self.affinity_map.adjust oc (fun s => s.erase id))).getD default |>.adjust target (fun s => s ∪ {id}),
        content_index := self.content_index,
        total_capacity := self.total_capacity,
        used_capacity := self.used_capacity }
  constructor
  case left =>
    simp
  case right =>
    simp [Finmap.lookup_insert]

def ContentAddressableStorage.getStatistics (self : ContentAddressableStorage) : StorageStatistics :=
  let entangled_count := self.storage.foldl (fun acc _ b => if b.state == MemoryBlockState.entangled then acc + 1 else acc) 0
  let util := if self.total_capacity > 0 then self.used_capacity / self.total_capacity else 0
  { total_blocks := self.storage.size
    entangled_blocks := entangled_count
    used_capacity := self.used_capacity
    total_capacity := self.total_capacity
    utilization := util
    unique_contents := self.content_index.size
    cores_with_affinity := self.affinity_map.size }

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.getStatistics_total_blocks (self : ContentAddressableStorage) :
  self.getStatistics.total_blocks = self.storage.size := by
  simp [getStatistics]

  storage : BlockStorage

  used_capacity : Nat
  deriving Repr

def ContentAddressableStorage.init (capacity : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
  { storage := default
    content_index := default

def sha256 (data : List UInt8) : Vector UInt8 32 :=
  let init := List.replicate 32 (0 : UInt8)
  let mixed := data.foldl (fun acc b =>
    acc.mapIdx (fun i x => x + b + (i.val.toUInt8 * 31))) init
  Vector.mk mixed (by simp)

def computeContentHash (data : List UInt8) : ContentHash :=
  let hash := sha256 data
  Vector.mk (hash.toList.take CONTENT_HASH_SIZE) (by
    simp only [List.length_take, List.length_replicate, min_self]
    exact content_hash_size_pos
  )

def computeBlockId (content_hash : ContentHash) (timestamp : Int) : BlockId :=
  let buf := content_hash.toList ++ (writeI128Little timestamp).toList
  let fullHash := sha256 buf
  Vector.mk (fullHash.toList.take BLOCK_ID_SIZE) (by
    simp only [List.length_take, List.length_replicate, min_self]
    exact block_id_size_pos
  )

theorem computeContentHash_deterministic (d1 d2 : List UInt8) (h : d1 = d2) :
  computeContentHash d1 = computeContentHash d2 := by
  simp [h]

def ContentAddressableStorage.containsBlock (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) : Bool :=
  Finmap.contains self.storage id

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.containsBlock_iff (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) :
  self.containsBlock id ↔ id ∈ self.storage := by
  simp [containsBlock, Finmap.contains, Finmap.mem_def]

def ContentAddressableStorage.getBlock (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) : Option MemoryBlock :=
  Finmap.lookup self.storage id

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.getBlock_mem (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) (block : MemoryBlock) :
  self.getBlock id = some block ↔ block ∈ self.storage ∧ block.block_id = id := by
  simp [getBlock, Finmap.lookup_eq_some]

def ContentAddressableStorage.store (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : List UInt8) (preferred_core : Option Nat) : Option (BlockId × ContentAddressableStorage) :=
  let content_hash := computeContentHash data
  match self.content_index.lookup content_hash with
  | some existing_blocks =>
    let rec findFirst (blocks : Finset BlockId) : Option BlockId :=
      blocks.toList.find? (fun id => self.storage.contains id)
    match findFirst existing_blocks with
    | some id =>
      let updateFn (b : MemoryBlock) : MemoryBlock := b.updateAccessTime
      let newStorage := Finmap.adjust self.storage id updateFn
      some (id, { self with storage := newStorage })
    | none =>
      let timestamp := self.used_capacity.toNat
      let block_id := computeBlockId content_hash timestamp
      let newBlock := MemoryBlock.init block_id content_hash data preferred_core
      let newStorage := Finmap.insert self.storage block_id newBlock
      let newCI := Finmap.adjust self.content_index content_hash (fun s => s ∪ {block_id})
      some (block_id, { self with storage := newStorage, content_index := newCI, used_capacity := self.used_capacity + data.length })
  | none =>
    let timestamp := self.used_capacity.toNat
    let block_id := computeBlockId content_hash timestamp
    let newBlock := MemoryBlock.init block_id content_hash data preferred_core
    let newStorage := Finmap.insert self.storage block_id newBlock
    let newCI := Finmap.insert self.content_index content_hash {block_id}
    some (block_id, { self with storage := newStorage, content_index := newCI, used_capacity := self.used_capacity + data.length })

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.store_increments_used (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : List UInt8) (pc : Option Nat) (hnew : ¬ (computeContentHash data ∈ self.content_index)) :
  let res := self.store data pc
  ∃ id st, res = some (id, st) ∧ st.used_capacity = self.used_capacity + data.length := by
  simp only [store]
  simp only [Finmap.lookup_eq_none_iff] at hnew
  simp [hnew]
  use computeBlockId (computeContentHash data) self.used_capacity.toNat

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.store_inserts_block (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : List UInt8) (pc : Option Nat) (hnew : ¬ (computeContentHash data ∈ self.content_index)) :
  let res := self.store data pc
  ∃ id st, res = some (id, st) ∧ st.containsBlock id := by
  simp only [store]
  simp only [Finmap.lookup_eq_none_iff] at hnew
  simp [hnew, containsBlock, Finmap.contains, Finmap.mem_def, Finmap.insert]
  use computeBlockId (computeContentHash data) self.used_capacity.toNat

def ContentAddressableStorage.retrieve (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) : Option (List UInt8) :=
  match self.storage.lookup id with
  | some block => some block.data
  | none => none

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.retrieve_none (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) (hn : ¬ self.containsBlock id) :
  self.retrieve id = none := by
  simp [retrieve, containsBlock, Finmap.contains] at hn ⊢
  exact Finmap.not_mem_lookup_iff.mpr hn

def ContentAddressableStorage.retrieveByContent (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : List UInt8) : Option BlockId :=
  let hash := computeContentHash data
  match self.content_index.lookup hash with
  | some ids => ids.toList.find? (fun id => self.storage.contains id)
  | none => none

def ContentAddressableStorage.entangleBlocks (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id1 id2 : BlockId) : Option ContentAddressableStorage :=
  if h1 : id1 ∈ self.storage ∧ id2 ∈ self.storage then
    if id1 ≠ id2 then
      let b1 := self.storage.lookup id1
      let b2 := self.storage.lookup id2
      match b1, b2 with
      | some block1, some block2 =>
        let nb1 := block1.addEntangledBlock id2
        let nb2 := block2.addEntangledBlock id1
        let st1 := Finmap.insert self.storage id1 { nb1 with state := MemoryBlockState.entangled }
        let st2 := Finmap.insert st1 id2 { nb2 with state := MemoryBlockState.entangled }
        some { self with storage := st2 }
      | _, _ => none
    else none
  else none

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.entangleBlocks_fails_same_id (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) :
  self.entangleBlocks id id = none := by
  simp [entangleBlocks]

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.entangleBlocks_fails_missing (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id1 id2 : BlockId) (h : id1 ∉ self.storage ∨ id2 ∉ self.storage) :
  self.entangleBlocks id1 id2 = none := by
  simp [entangleBlocks]
  split
  case isTrue hmem =>
    exfalso
    cases h with
    | inl h1 => exact h1 hmem.1
    | inr h2 => exact h2 hmem.2
  case isFalse hmem =>
    simp

def ContentAddressableStorage.migrateBlock (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) (target_core : Nat) : Option ContentAddressableStorage :=
  match self.storage.lookup id with
  | some block =>
    let updateAffinity (m : AffinityMap) (old : Option Nat) (new : Nat) (bid : BlockId) : AffinityMap :=
      match old with
      | some oc =>
        let m1 := m.adjust oc (fun s => s.erase id)
        m1.adjust new (fun s => s ∪ {id})
      | none =>
        m.adjust new (fun s => s ∪ {id})
    let newBlock := { block with affinity_core := some target_core, state := MemoryBlockState.allocated }
    let newStorage := Finmap.insert self.storage id newBlock
    let newAffinity := updateAffinity self.affinity_map block.affinity_core target_core id
    some { self with storage := newStorage, affinity_map := newAffinity }
  | none => none

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.migrateBlock_affinity (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) (target : Nat) (block : MemoryBlock) (hlookup : self.storage.lookup id = some block) :
  ∃ newSt, self.migrateBlock id target = some newSt ∧ (newSt.storage.lookup id).map (·.affinity_core) = some (some target) := by
  simp [migrateBlock, hlookup]
  use { storage := Finmap.insert self.storage id { block with affinity_core := some target, state := MemoryBlockState.allocated },
        affinity_map := (block.affinity_core.map (fun oc => self.affinity_map.adjust oc (fun s => s.erase id))).getD default |>.adjust target (fun s => s ∪ {id}),
        content_index := self.content_index,
        total_capacity := self.total_capacity,
        used_capacity := self.used_capacity }
  constructor
  case left =>
    simp
  case right =>
    simp [Finmap.lookup_insert]

def ContentAddressableStorage.getStatistics (self : ContentAddressableStorage) : StorageStatistics :=
  let entangled_count := self.storage.foldl (fun acc _ b => if b.state == MemoryBlockState.entangled then acc + 1 else acc) 0
  let util := if self.total_capacity > 0 then self.used_capacity / self.total_capacity else 0
  { total_blocks := self.storage.size
    entangled_blocks := entangled_count
    used_capacity := self.used_capacity
    total_capacity := self.total_capacity
    utilization := util
    unique_contents := self.content_index.size
    cores_with_affinity := self.affinity_map.size }

theorem ContentAddressableStorage.getStatistics_total_blocks (self : ContentAddressableStorage) :
  self.getStatistics.total_blocks = self.storage.size := by
  simp [getStatistics]

abbrev TaskQueue := List TaskDescriptor

structure DynamicTaskScheduler where
  pending_tasks : TaskQueue
  active_tasks : ActiveTaskMap
  completed_tasks : List TaskDescriptor
  task_counter : Nat
  deriving Repr

def DynamicTaskScheduler.init : DynamicTaskScheduler :=
  { pending_tasks := []
    active_tasks := default
    completed_tasks := []
    task_counter := 0 }

theorem DynamicTaskScheduler.init_counter : DynamicTaskScheduler.init.task_counter = 0 := by
  simp [DynamicTaskScheduler.init]

def DynamicTaskScheduler.compareTasks (t1 t2 : TaskDescriptor) : Ordering :=
  if t1.priority > t2.priority then Ordering.lt
  else if t1.priority < t2.priority then Ordering.gt
  else Ordering.eq

theorem DynamicTaskScheduler.compareTasks_antisym (t1 t2 : TaskDescriptor) :
  (compareTasks t1 t2).swap = compareTasks t2 t1 := by
  simp [compareTasks]
  split
  case isTrue h =>
    simp [h]
    split
    case isTrue h2 =>
      omega
    case isFalse h2 =>
      simp
  case isFalse h =>
    split
    case isTrue h2 =>
      simp [h2]
    case isFalse h2 =>
      simp

def DynamicTaskScheduler.generateTaskId (counter : Nat) (time : Int) : TaskId :=
  let buf := (writeU64Little counter.toUInt64).toList ++ (writeI128Little time).toList
  let hash := sha256 buf
  Vector.mk (hash.toList.take SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE) (by
    simp only [List.length_take, List.length_replicate, min_self]
    exact sha256_digest_size_pos
  )

def DynamicTaskScheduler.submitTask (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (priority : Int) (deps : List BlockId) (cycles : Nat) : TaskId × DynamicTaskScheduler :=
  let tid := generateTaskId self.task_counter 0
  let task : TaskDescriptor :=
    { task_id := tid
      priority := priority
      data_dependencies := deps
      estimated_cycles := cycles
      assigned_core := none
      completion_status := false
      start_time := 0
      end_time := 0 }
  let newPending := task :: self.pending_tasks
  (tid, { self with pending_tasks := newPending, task_counter := self.task_counter + 1 })

theorem DynamicTaskScheduler.submitTask_increments_counter (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (prio : Int) (deps : List BlockId) (cycles : Nat) :
  (self.submitTask prio deps cycles).2.task_counter = self.task_counter + 1 := by
  simp [submitTask]

def DynamicTaskScheduler.scheduleTask (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (cores : Finmap (fun _ : Nat => ProcessingCore)) (storage : ContentAddressableStorage) : Option (TaskDescriptor × DynamicTaskScheduler) :=
  match self.pending_tasks with
  | [] => none
  | t :: ts =>
    let scoredCores := cores.toList.filterMap (fun ⟨cid, core⟩ =>
      if core.state ≠ CoreState.power_gated then
        let score : Rat := t.data_dependencies.foldl (fun acc dep =>
          if storage.containsBlock dep then
            match storage.storage.lookup dep >>= (·.affinity_core) with
            | some ac => if ac = cid then acc + 10 else acc + 1
            | none => acc
          else acc
        ) 0
        some (cid, score)
      else none
    )
    let bestCores := scoredCores.toArray.qsort (fun a b => a.2 > b.2)
    if h : bestCores.size > 0 then
      let bestCid := (bestCores.get ⟨0, by omega⟩).1
      let newTask := { t with assigned_core := some bestCid, start_time := 1 }
      let newActive := Finmap.insert self.active_tasks t.task_id newTask
      some (newTask, { self with pending_tasks := ts, active_tasks := newActive })
    else none

theorem DynamicTaskScheduler.scheduleTask_empty_pending (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (h : self.pending_tasks = []) :
  self.scheduleTask cores storage = none := by
  simp [scheduleTask, h]

def DynamicTaskScheduler.completeTask (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (tid : TaskId) : Option (TaskDescriptor × DynamicTaskScheduler) :=
  match self.active_tasks.lookup tid with
  | some task =>
    let completed := { task with completion_status := true, end_time := 1 }
    let newCompleted := completed :: self.completed_tasks
    let newActive := self.active_tasks.erase tid
    some (completed, { self with active_tasks := newActive, completed_tasks := newCompleted })
  | none => none

theorem DynamicTaskScheduler.completeTask_removes_active (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (tid : TaskId) (task : TaskDescriptor) (h : self.active_tasks.lookup tid = some task) :
  ∃ newSched, self.completeTask tid = some (task, newSched) ∧ tid ∉ newSched.active_tasks := by
  simp [completeTask, h]
  use { active_tasks := self.active_tasks.erase tid, pending_tasks := self.pending_tasks, completed_tasks := { task with completion_status := true, end_time := 1 } :: self.completed_tasks, task_counter := self.task_counter }
  constructor
  case left =>
    simp
  case right =>
    simp [Finmap.mem_def]

structure AccessRecord where
  timestamp : Int
  core_id : Nat
  deriving Repr

structure DataFlowAnalyzer where
  flow_graph : Finmap (fun _ : BlockId => Finset BlockId)
  flow_weights : Finmap (fun _ : BlockId × BlockId => Rat)
  access_patterns : Finmap (fun _ : BlockId => List AccessRecord)
  deriving Repr

def DataFlowAnalyzer.init : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
  { flow_graph := default
    flow_weights := default
    access_patterns := default }

def DataFlowAnalyzer.recordAccess (self : DataFlowAnalyzer) (block_id : BlockId) (core_id : Nat) : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
  let newRecord : AccessRecord := ⟨1, core_id⟩
  let newPatterns := self.access_patterns.adjust block_id (fun lst => newRecord :: lst)
  { self with access_patterns := newPatterns }

theorem DataFlowAnalyzer.recordAccess_adds_record (self : DataFlowAnalyzer) (bid : BlockId) (cid : Nat) :
  let newDFA := self.recordAccess bid cid
  ∃ lst, newDFA.access_patterns.lookup bid = some lst ∧ lst.head? = some ⟨1, cid⟩ := by
  simp [recordAccess]
  use (self.access_patterns.lookup bid).getD [] |>.cons ⟨1, cid⟩
  simp [Finmap.lookup_adjust]

def DataFlowAnalyzer.buildFlowGraph (self : DataFlowAnalyzer) (tasks : List TaskDescriptor) : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
  tasks.foldl (fun acc task =>
    task.data_dependencies.foldl (fun acc2 dep1 =>
      task.data_dependencies.foldl (fun acc3 dep2 =>
        if dep1 = dep2 then acc3
        else
          let fg := acc3.flow_graph.adjust dep1 (fun s => s ∪ {dep2})
          let fg' := fg.adjust dep2 (fun s => s ∪ {dep1})
          let key := if dep1 < dep2 then (dep1, dep2) else (dep2, dep1)
          let fw := acc3.flow_weights.adjust key (fun w => w + 1)
          { acc3 with flow_graph := fg', flow_weights := fw }
      ) acc2
    ) acc
  ) self

theorem DataFlowAnalyzer.buildFlowGraph_symmetric (self : DataFlowAnalyzer) (tasks : List TaskDescriptor) (b1 b2 : BlockId) :
  let newDFA := self.buildFlowGraph tasks
  b2 ∈ (newDFA.flow_graph.lookup b1).getD ∅ ↔ b1 ∈ (newDFA.flow_graph.lookup b2).getD ∅ := by
  sorry

def ContentAddressableStorage.store (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : List UInt8) (preferred_core : Option Nat) : Option (BlockId × ContentAddressableStorage) :=
  let content_hash := computeContentHash data
  match self.content_index.lookup content_hash with
  | some existing_blocks =>
    let rec findFirst (blocks : Finset BlockId) : Option BlockId :=
      blocks.toList.find? (fun id => self.storage.contains id)
    match findFirst existing_blocks with
    | some id =>
      let updateFn (b : MemoryBlock) : MemoryBlock := b.updateAccessTime
      let newStorage := Finmap.adjust self.storage id updateFn
      some (id, { self with storage := newStorage })
    | none =>
      let timestamp := self.used_capacity.toNat
      let block_id := computeBlockId content_hash timestamp
      let newBlock := MemoryBlock.init block_id content_hash data preferred_core
      let newStorage := Finmap.insert self.storage block_id newBlock
      let newCI := Finmap.adjust self.content_index content_hash (fun s => s ∪ {block_id})
      some (block_id, { self with storage := newStorage, content_index := newCI, used_capacity := self.used_capacity + data.length })
  | none =>
    let timestamp := self.used_capacity.toNat
    let block_id := computeBlockId content_hash timestamp
    let newBlock := MemoryBlock.init block_id content_hash data preferred_core
    let newStorage := Finmap.insert self.storage block_id newBlock
    let newCI := Finmap.insert self.content_index content_hash {block_id}
    some (block_id, { self with storage := newStorage, content_index := newCI, used_capacity := self.used_capacity + data.length })

  ∃ id st, res = some (id, st) ∧ st.used_capacity = self.used_capacity + data.length := by

  simp only [Finmap.lookup_eq_none_iff] at hnew

  if h1 : id1 ∈ self.storage ∧ id2 ∈ self.storage then

      let b1 := self.storage.lookup id1
      let b2 := self.storage.lookup id2

      | some block1, some block2 =>
        let nb1 := block1.addEntangledBlock id2
        let nb2 := block2.addEntangledBlock id1
        let st1 := Finmap.insert self.storage id1 { nb1 with state := MemoryBlockState.entangled }
        let st2 := Finmap.insert st1 id2 { nb2 with state := MemoryBlockState.entangled }

    else none
  else none

def ContentAddressableStorage.migrateBlock (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (id : BlockId) (target_core : Nat) : Option ContentAddressableStorage :=

  | some block =>

    simp only [List.length_take, List.length_replicate, min_self]
    exact sha256_digest_size_pos
  )

  let task : TaskDescriptor :=
    { task_id := tid
      priority := priority
      data_dependencies := deps
      estimated_cycles := cycles
      assigned_core := none
      completion_status := false
      start_time := 0
      end_time := 0 }
  let newPending := task :: self.pending_tasks
  (tid, { self with pending_tasks := newPending, task_counter := self.task_counter + 1 })

def DynamicTaskScheduler.scheduleTask (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (cores : Finmap (fun _ : Nat => ProcessingCore)) (storage : ContentAddressableStorage) : Option (TaskDescriptor × DynamicTaskScheduler) :=
  match self.pending_tasks with
  | [] => none
  | t :: ts =>
    let scoredCores := cores.toList.filterMap (fun ⟨cid, core⟩ =>
      if core.state ≠ CoreState.power_gated then
        let score : Rat := t.data_dependencies.foldl (fun acc dep =>
          if storage.containsBlock dep then
            match storage.storage.lookup dep >>= (·.affinity_core) with
            | some ac => if ac = cid then acc + 10 else acc + 1
            | none => acc
          else acc
        ) 0
        some (cid, score)
      else none
    )
    let bestCores := scoredCores.toArray.qsort (fun a b => a.2 > b.2)
    if h : bestCores.size > 0 then
      let bestCid := (bestCores.get ⟨0, by omega⟩).1
      let newTask := { t with assigned_core := some bestCid, start_time := 1 }
      let newActive := Finmap.insert self.active_tasks t.task_id newTask
      some (newTask, { self with pending_tasks := ts, active_tasks := newActive })
    else none

theorem DynamicTaskScheduler.scheduleTask_empty_pending (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (h : self.pending_tasks = []) :
  self.scheduleTask cores storage = none := by
  simp [scheduleTask, h]

def DynamicTaskScheduler.completeTask (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (tid : TaskId) : Option (TaskDescriptor × DynamicTaskScheduler) :=

  | some task =>
    let completed := { task with completion_status := true, end_time := 1 }

    block_id: [ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8,
    content_hash: [ChaosCoreConfig.CONTENT_HASH_SIZE]u8,
    data: []u8,
    size: usize,
    state: MemoryBlockState,
    affinity_core: ?usize,
    access_count: usize,
    last_access_time: i128,
    entangled_blocks: BlockIdSet,
    allocator: Allocator,

    pub fn init(
        allocator: Allocator,
        block_id: [ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8,
        content_hash: [ChaosCoreConfig.CONTENT_HASH_SIZE]u8,
        data: []const u8,
        preferred_core: ?usize,
    ) !MemoryBlock {
        var dataCopy = try allocator.alloc(u8, data.len);
        @memcpy(dataCopy, data);
        return MemoryBlock{
            .block_id = block_id,
            .content_hash = content_hash,
            .data = dataCopy,
            .size = data.len,
            .state = .allocated,
            .affinity_core = preferred_core,
            .access_count = 1,
            .last_access_time = 0,
            .entangled_blocks = BlockIdSet.init(allocator),
            .allocator = allocator,
        };
    }

    pub fn deinit(self: *MemoryBlock) void {
        self.allocator.free(self.data);
        self.entangled_blocks.deinit();
    }

    pub fn updateAccessTime(self: *MemoryBlock) void {
        self.access_count += 1;
        self.last_access_time += 1;
    }

    pub fn addEntangledBlock(self: *MemoryBlock, other: [ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8) !void {
        try self.entangled_blocks.put(other, {});
    }

    pub fn removeEntangledBlock(self: *MemoryBlock, other: [ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8) void {
        _ = self.entangled_blocks.remove(other);
    }

    pub fn hasEntanglement(self: *const MemoryBlock, other: [ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8) bool {
        return self.entangled_blocks.contains(other);
    }

    pub fn entangledCount(self: *const MemoryBlock) usize {
        return self.entangled_blocks.count();
    }
};

        return .{
            .task_id = task_id,
            .priority = priority,
            .data_dependencies = ArrayList([ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8).init(allocator),
            .estimated_cycles = estimated_cycles,
            .assigned_core = null,
            .completion_status = false,
            .start_time = 0,
            .end_time = 0,
        };
    }

    pub fn deinit(self: *TaskDescriptor) void {
        self.data_dependencies.deinit();
    }

    pub fn addDependency(self: *TaskDescriptor, dep: [ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8) !void {

    pub fn getDuration(self: *const TaskDescriptor) i128 {

            return self.end_time - self.start_time;
        }
        return 0;
    }
};

pub const CoreState = enum(u8) {
    idle = 0,
    active = 1,
    power_gated = 2,
    stalled = 3,
};

pub const ProcessingCore = struct {
    core_id: usize,
    state: CoreState,
    cycles_active: usize,
    cycles_idle: usize,

    pub fn init(core_id: usize) ProcessingCore {
        return .{
            .core_id = core_id,
            .state = .idle,
            .cycles_active = 0,
            .cycles_idle = 0,
        };
    }

    pub fn tick(self: *ProcessingCore, is_active: bool) void {
        if (is_active) {
            self.cycles_active += 1;
            self.state = .active;
        } else {
            self.cycles_idle += 1;
            if (self.state != .power_gated) {
                self.state = .idle;
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn getWorkload(self: *const ProcessingCore) f64 {
        const total = self.cycles_active + self.cycles_idle;
        if (total == 0) return 0.0;
        return @as(f64, @floatFromInt(self.cycles_active)) / @as(f64, @floatFromInt(total));
    }
};

pub const ContentAddressableStorage = struct {
    storage: AutoHashMap([ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8, MemoryBlock),
    content_index: AutoHashMap([ChaosCoreConfig.CONTENT_HASH_SIZE]u8, ArrayList([ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8)),
    affinity_map: AutoHashMap(usize, ArrayList([ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8)),
    total_capacity: usize,
    used_capacity: usize,
    allocator: Allocator,

    pub fn init(allocator: Allocator, capacity: usize) ContentAddressableStorage {
        return .{
            .storage = AutoHashMap([ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8, MemoryBlock).init(allocator),
            .content_index = AutoHashMap([ChaosCoreConfig.CONTENT_HASH_SIZE]u8, ArrayList([ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8)).init(allocator),
            .affinity_map = AutoHashMap(usize, ArrayList([ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8)).init(allocator),
            .total_capacity = capacity,
            .used_capacity = 0,
            .allocator = allocator,
        };
    }

    pub fn deinit(self: *ContentAddressableStorage) void {
        var iter = self.storage.valueIterator();
        while (iter.next()) |block| {
            var blk = block.*;
            blk.deinit();
        }
        self.storage.deinit();

        var ciIter = self.content_index.valueIterator();
        while (ciIter.next()) |list| {
            list.deinit();
        }
        self.content_index.deinit();

        var amIter = self.affinity_map.valueIterator();
        while (amIter.next()) |list| {
            list.deinit();
        }
        self.affinity_map.deinit();
    }

    fn computeContentHash(data: []const u8) [ChaosCoreConfig.CONTENT_HASH_SIZE]u8 {
        var hash: [Sha256.digest_length]u8 = undefined;
        Sha256.hash(data, &hash, .{});
        var result: [ChaosCoreConfig.CONTENT_HASH_SIZE]u8 = undefined;
        @memcpy(result[0..ChaosCoreConfig.CONTENT_HASH_SIZE], hash[0..ChaosCoreConfig.CONTENT_HASH_SIZE]);
        return result;
    }

    fn computeBlockId(content_hash: [ChaosCoreConfig.CONTENT_HASH_SIZE]u8, timestamp: i128) [ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8 {
        var buf: [ChaosCoreConfig.CONTENT_HASH_SIZE + 16]u8 = undefined;
        @memcpy(buf[0..ChaosCoreConfig.CONTENT_HASH_SIZE], &content_hash);
        writeI128Little(buf[ChaosCoreConfig.CONTENT_HASH_SIZE..], timestamp);
        var hash: [Sha256.digest_length]u8 = undefined;
        Sha256.hash(&buf, &hash, .{});
        var result: [ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8 = undefined;
        @memcpy(result[0..ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE], hash[0..ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]);
        return result;
    }

    pub fn containsBlock(self: *const ContentAddressableStorage, id: [ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8) bool {
        return self.storage.contains(id);
    }

    pub fn getBlock(self: *const ContentAddressableStorage, id: [ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8) ?*const MemoryBlock {
        return self.storage.getPtr(id);
    }

    pub fn store(self: *ContentAddressableStorage, data: []const u8, preferred_core: ?usize) !?[ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8 {
        const content_hash = computeContentHash(data);

        if (self.content_index.get(content_hash)) |existing_blocks| {
            for (existing_blocks.items) |id| {
                if (self.storage.getPtr(id)) |block| {
                    var mutable_block = block.*;
                    mutable_block.updateAccessTime();
                    try self.storage.put(id, mutable_block);
                    return id;
                }
            }
        }

        const timestamp: i128 = @intCast(self.used_capacity);
        const block_id = computeBlockId(content_hash, timestamp);
        const newBlock = try MemoryBlock.init(self.allocator, block_id, content_hash, data, preferred_core);
        try self.storage.put(block_id, newBlock);

        const gop = try self.content_index.getOrPut(content_hash);
        if (!gop.found_existing) {
            gop.value_ptr.* = ArrayList([ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8).init(self.allocator);
        }
        try gop.value_ptr.append(block_id);

        self.used_capacity += data.len;
        return block_id;
    }

    pub fn retrieve(self: *const ContentAddressableStorage, id: [ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8) ?[]const u8 {
        if (self.storage.get(id)) |block| {
            return block.data;
        }
        return null;
    }

    pub fn retrieveByContent(self: *const ContentAddressableStorage, data: []const u8) ?[ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8 {
        const hash = computeContentHash(data);
        if (self.content_index.get(hash)) |ids| {
            for (ids.items) |id| {
                if (self.storage.contains(id)) {
                    return id;
                }
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    pub fn entangleBlocks(self: *ContentAddressableStorage, id1: [ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8, id2: [ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8) !bool {
        if (std.mem.eql(u8, &id1, &id2)) return false;
        if (!self.storage.contains(id1) or !self.storage.contains(id2)) return false;

        var block1 = self.storage.get(id1).?;
        var block2 = self.storage.get(id2).?;

        try block1.addEntangledBlock(id2);
        try block2.addEntangledBlock(id1);

        block1.state = .entangled;
        block2.state = .entangled;

        try self.storage.put(id1, block1);
        try self.storage.put(id2, block2);

        return true;
    }

    pub fn migrateBlock(self: *ContentAddressableStorage, id: [ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8, target_core: usize) !bool {
        if (!self.storage.contains(id)) return false;

        var block = self.storage.get(id).?;

        if (block.affinity_core) |old_core| {
            if (self.affinity_map.getPtr(old_core)) |list| {
                var i: usize = 0;
                while (i < list.items.len) : (i += 1) {
                    if (std.mem.eql(u8, &list.items[i], &id)) {
                        _ = list.swapRemove(i);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        block.affinity_core = target_core;
        block.state = .allocated;

        const gop = try self.affinity_map.getOrPut(target_core);
        if (!gop.found_existing) {
            gop.value_ptr.* = ArrayList([ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8).init(self.allocator);
        }
        try gop.value_ptr.append(id);

        try self.storage.put(id, block);

        return true;
    }

    pub fn getStatistics(self: *const ContentAddressableStorage) StorageStatistics {
        var entangled_count: usize = 0;
        var iter = self.storage.valueIterator();
        while (iter.next()) |block| {
            if (block.state == .entangled) {
                entangled_count += 1;
            }
        }

        const util = if (self.total_capacity > 0) @as(f64, @floatFromInt(self.used_capacity)) / @as(f64, @floatFromInt(self.total_capacity)) else 0.0;

        return .{
            .total_blocks = self.storage.count(),
            .entangled_blocks = entangled_count,
            .used_capacity = self.used_capacity,
            .total_capacity = self.total_capacity,
            .utilization = util,
            .unique_contents = self.content_index.count(),
            .cores_with_affinity = self.affinity_map.count(),
        };
    }
};

pub const TaskIdContext = struct {
    pub fn hash(_: @This(), key: [ChaosCoreConfig.SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE]u8) u64 {
        var hasher = std.hash.Wyhash.init(0);
        hasher.update(std.mem.asBytes(&key));
        return hasher.final();
    }

    pub fn eql(_: @This(), a: [ChaosCoreConfig.SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE]u8, b: [ChaosCoreConfig.SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE]u8) bool {
        return std.mem.eql(u8, a[0..], b[0..]);
    }
};

pub const DynamicTaskScheduler = struct {
    pending_tasks: ArrayList(TaskDescriptor),
    active_tasks: std.HashMap([ChaosCoreConfig.SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE]u8, TaskDescriptor, TaskIdContext, std.hash_map.default_max_load_percentage),
    completed_tasks: ArrayList(TaskDescriptor),
    task_counter: usize,
    allocator: Allocator,

    pub fn init(allocator: Allocator) DynamicTaskScheduler {
        return .{
            .pending_tasks = ArrayList(TaskDescriptor).init(allocator),
            .active_tasks = std.HashMap([ChaosCoreConfig.SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE]u8, TaskDescriptor, TaskIdContext, std.hash_map.default_max_load_percentage).init(allocator),
            .completed_tasks = ArrayList(TaskDescriptor).init(allocator),
            .task_counter = 0,
            .allocator = allocator,
        };
    }

    pub fn deinit(self: *DynamicTaskScheduler) void {
        for (self.pending_tasks.items) |*task| {
            task.deinit();
        }
        self.pending_tasks.deinit();

        var iter = self.active_tasks.valueIterator();
        while (iter.next()) |task| {
            var t = task.*;
            t.deinit();
        }
        self.active_tasks.deinit();

        for (self.completed_tasks.items) |*task| {
            task.deinit();
        }
        self.completed_tasks.deinit();
    }

    fn generateTaskId(counter: usize, time: i128) [ChaosCoreConfig.SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE]u8 {
        var buf: [8 + 16]u8 = undefined;
        writeU64Little(buf[0..8], counter);
        writeI128Little(buf[8..], time);
        var hash: [Sha256.digest_length]u8 = undefined;
        Sha256.hash(&buf, &hash, .{});
        return hash;
    }

    pub fn submitTask(self: *DynamicTaskScheduler, priority: i32, deps: []const [ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8, cycles: usize) !?[ChaosCoreConfig.SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE]u8 {
        const tid = generateTaskId(self.task_counter, 0);
        var task = TaskDescriptor.init(self.allocator, tid, priority, cycles);
        for (deps) |dep| {
            try task.addDependency(dep);
        }
        try self.pending_tasks.append(task);
        self.task_counter += 1;
        return tid;
    }

    pub fn scheduleTask(self: *DynamicTaskScheduler, cores: *const AutoHashMap(usize, ProcessingCore), storage: *const ContentAddressableStorage) !?TaskDescriptor {
        if (self.pending_tasks.items.len == 0) return null;

        const task = self.pending_tasks.orderedRemove(0);

        var scoredCores = ArrayList(struct { core_id: usize, score: f64 }).init(self.allocator);
        defer scoredCores.deinit();

        var coreIter = cores.iterator();
        while (coreIter.next()) |entry| {
            const cid = entry.key_ptr.*;
            const core = entry.value_ptr.*;
            if (core.state != .power_gated) {
                var score: f64 = 0.0;
                for (task.data_dependencies.items) |dep| {
                    if (storage.containsBlock(dep)) {
                        if (storage.getBlock(dep)) |block| {
                            if (block.affinity_core) |ac| {
                                if (ac == cid) {
                                    score += 10.0;
                                } else {
                                    score += 1.0;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                try scoredCores.append(.{ .core_id = cid, .score = score });
            }
        }

        if (scoredCores.items.len == 0) {
            try self.pending_tasks.insert(0, task);
            return null;
        }

        const bestCore = scoredCores.items[0];
        var newTask = task;
        newTask.assigned_core = bestCore.core_id;
        newTask.start_time = 1;

        try self.active_tasks.put(task.task_id, newTask);

        return newTask;
    }

    pub fn completeTask(self: *DynamicTaskScheduler, tid: [ChaosCoreConfig.SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE]u8) !?TaskDescriptor {
        if (self.active_tasks.fetchRemove(tid)) |entry| {
            var task = entry.value;
            task.completion_status = true;
            task.end_time = 1;
            try self.completed_tasks.append(task);
            return task;
        }
        return null;
    }
};

pub const AccessRecord = struct {
    timestamp: i128,
    core_id: usize,
};

pub const DataFlowAnalyzer = struct {
    flow_graph: AutoHashMap([ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8, ArrayList([ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8)),
    flow_weights: AutoHashMap([ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE * 2]u8, f64),
    access_patterns: AutoHashMap([ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8, ArrayList(AccessRecord)),
    allocator: Allocator,

    pub fn init(allocator: Allocator) DataFlowAnalyzer {
        return .{
            .flow_graph = AutoHashMap([ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8, ArrayList([ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8)).init(allocator),
            .flow_weights = AutoHashMap([ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE * 2]u8, f64).init(allocator),
            .access_patterns = AutoHashMap([ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8, ArrayList(AccessRecord)).init(allocator),
            .allocator = allocator,
        };
    }

    pub fn deinit(self: *DataFlowAnalyzer) void {
        var fgIter = self.flow_graph.valueIterator();
        while (fgIter.next()) |list| {
            list.deinit();
        }
        self.flow_graph.deinit();

        self.flow_weights.deinit();

        var apIter = self.access_patterns.valueIterator();
        while (apIter.next()) |list| {
            list.deinit();
        }
        self.access_patterns.deinit();
    }

    pub fn recordAccess(self: *DataFlowAnalyzer, block_id: [ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8, core_id: usize) !void {
        const gop = try self.access_patterns.getOrPut(block_id);
        if (!gop.found_existing) {
            gop.value_ptr.* = ArrayList(AccessRecord).init(self.allocator);
        }
        try gop.value_ptr.append(.{ .timestamp = 1, .core_id = core_id });
    }

    pub fn buildFlowGraph(self: *DataFlowAnalyzer, tasks: []const TaskDescriptor) !void {
        for (tasks) |task| {
            for (task.data_dependencies.items) |dep1| {
                for (task.data_dependencies.items) |dep2| {
                    if (!std.mem.eql(u8, &dep1, &dep2)) {
                        const gop1 = try self.flow_graph.getOrPut(dep1);
                        if (!gop1.found_existing) {
                            gop1.value_ptr.* = ArrayList([ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8).init(self.allocator);
                        }
                        try gop1.value_ptr.append(dep2);

                        const gop2 = try self.flow_graph.getOrPut(dep2);
                        if (!gop2.found_existing) {
                            gop2.value_ptr.* = ArrayList([ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8).init(self.allocator);
                        }
                        try gop2.value_ptr.append(dep1);

                        var key: [ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE * 2]u8 = undefined;
                        if (std.mem.lessThan(u8, &dep1, &dep2)) {
                            @memcpy(key[0..ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE], &dep1);
                            @memcpy(key[ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE..], &dep2);
                        } else {
                            @memcpy(key[0..ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE], &dep2);
                            @memcpy(key[ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE..], &dep1);
                        }

                        const gopW = try self.flow_weights.getOrPut(key);
                        if (!gopW.found_existing) {
                            gopW.value_ptr.* = 0.0;
                        }
                        gopW.value_ptr.* += 1.0;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
};

pub const ChaosCoreKernel = struct {
    storage: ContentAddressableStorage,
    scheduler: DynamicTaskScheduler,
    flow_analyzer: DataFlowAnalyzer,
    cores: AutoHashMap(usize, ProcessingCore),
    cycle_count: usize,
    migration_count: usize,
    allocator: Allocator,

    pub fn init(allocator: Allocator) ChaosCoreKernel {
        return .{
            .storage = ContentAddressableStorage.init(allocator, ChaosCoreConfig.DEFAULT_BLOCK_SIZE),
            .scheduler = DynamicTaskScheduler.init(allocator),
            .flow_analyzer = DataFlowAnalyzer.init(allocator),
            .cores = AutoHashMap(usize, ProcessingCore).init(allocator),
            .cycle_count = 0,
            .migration_count = 0,
            .allocator = allocator,
        };
    }

    pub fn deinit(self: *ChaosCoreKernel) void {
        self.storage.deinit();
        self.scheduler.deinit();
        self.flow_analyzer.deinit();
        self.cores.deinit();
    }

    pub fn addCore(self: *ChaosCoreKernel, core_id: usize) !void {
        const newCore = ProcessingCore.init(core_id);
        try self.cores.put(core_id, newCore);
    }

    pub fn removeCore(self: *ChaosCoreKernel, core_id: usize) void {
        _ = self.cores.remove(core_id);
        _ = self.storage.affinity_map.remove(core_id);
    }

    pub fn setCoreState(self: *ChaosCoreKernel, core_id: usize, state: CoreState) !void {
        if (self.cores.getPtr(core_id)) |core| {
            core.state = state;
        }
    }

    pub fn allocateMemory(self: *ChaosCoreKernel, data: []const u8, preferred_core: ?usize) !?[ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8 {
        return try self.storage.store(data, preferred_core);
    }

    pub fn readMemory(self: *ChaosCoreKernel, block_id: [ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8) ?[]const u8 {
        if (self.storage.storage.getPtr(block_id)) |block| {
            var mutable_block = block.*;
            mutable_block.updateAccessTime();
            self.storage.storage.put(block_id, mutable_block) catch {};
            return mutable_block.data;
        }
        return null;
    }

    pub fn createTask(self: *ChaosCoreKernel, priority: i32, deps: []const [ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8, cycles: usize) !?[ChaosCoreConfig.SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE]u8 {
        const tid = try self.scheduler.submitTask(priority, deps, cycles);
        if (tid) |t| {
            const tmpTask = TaskDescriptor.init(self.allocator, t, priority, cycles);
            try self.flow_analyzer.buildFlowGraph(&[_]TaskDescriptor{tmpTask});
        }
        return tid;
    }

    pub fn finishTask(self: *ChaosCoreKernel, task_id: [ChaosCoreConfig.SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE]u8) !?TaskDescriptor {
        return try self.scheduler.completeTask(task_id);
    }

    pub fn entangleData(self: *ChaosCoreKernel, bid1: [ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8, bid2: [ChaosCoreConfig.BLOCK_ID_SIZE]u8) !bool {
        return try self.storage.entangleBlocks(bid1, bid2);
    }

    pub fn getKernelStatistics(self: *const ChaosCoreKernel) KernelStatistics {
        return .{
            .cycle_count = self.cycle_count,
            .migration_count = self.migration_count,
            .storage = self.storage.getStatistics(),
            .scheduler = .{
                .pending_tasks = self.scheduler.pending_tasks.items.len,
                .active_tasks = self.scheduler.active_tasks.count(),
                .completed_tasks = self.scheduler.completed_tasks.items.len,
                .average_completion_time = 0.0,
            },
        };
    }

    pub fn executeCycle(self: *ChaosCoreKernel) !void {
        const scheduledTask = try self.scheduler.scheduleTask(&self.cores, &self.storage);

        const activeCoreId: ?usize = if (scheduledTask) |t| t.assigned_core else null;

        var coreIter = self.cores.iterator();
        while (coreIter.next()) |entry| {
            const cid = entry.key_ptr.*;
            const core = entry.value_ptr;
            const isActive = if (activeCoreId) |ac| ac == cid else false;
            core.tick(isActive);
        }

        self.cycle_count += 1;
    }

    pub fn selfOrganize(self: *ChaosCoreKernel) !void {}
};
